title: Someone Built a Free Open Source Higgsfield — Full Cinema Studio
description:
One developer just built a completely free open source 
alternative to Higgsfield — and it's all on one GitHub repo.

Open Generative AI is a free open source AI image, video, 
cinema and lip sync studio — no content filters, no prompt 
rejections, no guardrails. Just full creative freedom. 

Built by developer Anil Matcha — and it's already exploding.

Here's everything it includes 👇

✅ 200+ state of the art AI models — Flux, Midjourney, Kling, 
Sora, Veo and more — all from one interface 
✅ Cinema Studio — photorealistic cinematic shots with pro camera 
controls — lens, focal length, aperture 
✅ Image Studio — 50+ text to image and 55+ image to image models
✅ Video Studio — 40+ text to video and 60+ image to video models
✅ Workflow Studio — build and run multi-step AI pipelines visually 
✅ Your data stays on your machine — full creative control 
✅ MIT licensed — completely free, no subscription, no vendor lock-in

----------------------------------------
🔔 Subscribe for daily free AI tools that actually work.
----------------------------------------
